layout.hierarchy: The neural network diagram dominates visually due to central placement and dense node/arrow complexity. The red Error bar and red question mark are secondary visual accents. The yellow '8' circle is a small tertiary marker. No title text competes for attention.

visual_elements.description: Neural network architecture diagram inside a beige rectangular box. Leftmost column shows vertical purple input dots. Arrows fan out to a column of blue circles each containing a sigma (Σ) symbol. Small labels 'Net', 'O', and 'w' appear near connections/nodes. Arrows continue to a column of green circles each containing a sigma (Σ) symbol, with similar small labels. To the right of green nodes are text labels 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output m'. Curved black arrows arc over the top connecting output nodes. At bottom left inside the box is 'Multi Bias' with a purple dot. At bottom center is an up arrow, a purple circle containing '1', and another up arrow.
Vertical red rectangular bar labeled 'Error' in white vertical text. To its right are three labels: 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m'.
Mathematical expression '∂E/∂w_ij' in black text followed by a large red question mark '?'.
Yellow circle with thick black outline containing the black number '8'.

imagery.description: Neural network diagram illustration showing layered nodes with sigma activation symbols, weighted connections, bias, and output mappings.
imagery.style: Flat vector-style schematic with colored circles and arrows

typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Labels appear in small black text. 'Error' is white vertical text on red background. The question mark is large and red. Number '8' is black inside yellow circle. No all-caps or italics clearly visible. No numbered bullets.
recreation_brief: 1. Create a new PowerPoint slide with a light gray (#f0f0f0) background. 2. Draw a thin red border (#c0392b) around the slide content area. 3. Add a black rectangular strip along the very bottom edge. 4. In the upper-middle, draw a beige rectangle (#e8e0d0) as the diagram container. 5. Inside the container, draw a column of purple dots on the far left. 6. Draw blue circles (#3498db) each containing a black sigma (Σ) symbol; connect them from the purple dots with arrows. 7. Add small black labels 'Net', 'O', and 'w' near the blue nodes/connections. 8. Draw green circles (#2ecc71) each containing a black sigma (Σ) symbol to the right of the blue layer; connect with arrows. 9. Add small black labels 'Net', 'O', and 'w' near the green nodes/connections. 10. To the right of green nodes, add text labels 'Output 1', 'Output 2', 'Output m'. 11. Draw curved black arrows arching over the top connecting the green output nodes. 12. At bottom left inside the container, add a purple dot and the text 'Multi Bias'. 13. At bottom center inside the container, draw an up arrow, a purple circle containing '1', and another up arrow. 14. To the right of the beige container, draw a vertical red bar (#c0392b) with white vertical text 'Error'. 15. To the right of the red bar, add black text labels 'Class 1', 'Class 2', 'Class m'. 16. At the far right, add black text '∂E/∂w_ij' followed by a large red question mark '?'. 17. At the top-right corner of the slide, draw a yellow circle (#f1c40f) with a black outline containing the black number '8'. 18. Do not add any title or subtitle text.
